# Equip

> Equip (equipbible.com) is a free platform for systematic Bible study: courses in a fixed order, real assessment (essays among the four question types, read by a teacher) and a certificate anyone can check. Courses are taught by organizations — Bible schools, churches and ministries — and are read in English, Russian, Ukrainian or German.

- Every course in the catalogue is free to take, and so is the certificate at the end of it.
- The catalogue and every course page are open to anyone without an account. Enrolling, quizzes and progress need a free account (email or Google sign-in).
- A course reaches the catalogue only once it exists in all four languages; Scripture is quoted from a published Bible translation in each.
- Certificates are issued in English; each carries its own number, checkable on the verification page.
- Equip is open source (MIT): https://github.com/ArVaViT/equip

## Public pages

- [Course catalogue](https://equipbible.com/courses): every public course, searchable (`https://equipbible.com/courses?q=<words>`). Each course has a page at `https://equipbible.com/courses/<course id>` with its description, modules and lessons; the first lesson can be read without an account
- [Organizations](https://equipbible.com/organizations): the schools, churches and ministries teaching on Equip; each has a page at `https://equipbible.com/o/<slug>`
- [Verify a certificate](https://equipbible.com/verify): enter the number printed on a certificate; no account needed
- [Sitemap](https://equipbible.com/sitemap.xml): every public page, including each course and organization

## Public API (read-only, no authentication)

- [List or search courses](https://api.equipbible.com/api/v1/courses): `GET /api/v1/courses?search=<words>&limit=<1-200>`; the `Accept-Language` header (`en`, `ru`, `uk`, `de`) picks the language of titles and descriptions
- [One course](https://api.equipbible.com/api/v1/courses): `GET /api/v1/courses/<course id>` — title, description, modules and lesson titles
